title: “Derived” verification state
summary: VerificationMark gains a fifth state, `derived` (sparkles glyph, info colour, word “Derived”), for attributes computed from verified data. The four existing states are unchanged.
migration: Additive: VerificationState widens to include "derived"; the app's own 4-state type in passport-view.ts stays assignable. Use it only with wording that says what it was derived from.
